notes.title: Demo version
notes.notes:
The demo version is now available. Now you can try Winter Novel by yourself before purchase. Hesitating before buying? Try the demo!
The windows version of Winter Novel was significantly optimized. Now the game starts really fast. Also, fun video:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SMPIwhvNGaU
